question: Does training and evaluating the unchanged v1 LFCC/Swin and logistic recipes on every non-overlapping 500-sample window of ECGData.mat, instead of 10 sampled windows per row, change held-out patient performance?

data.grid: non-overlapping, start = j * 500 for j = 0..130; final 36 samples of each 65,536-sample row unused

reference_v1.subset_check: the 1,620 v1 windows must be exactly grid windows (row, start/500) with bit-identical z-scored samples and LFCC features

folds.source: v1 per-window fold column mapped to patients (five StratifiedGroupKFold folds, seed 0, from results/patient_vmd_wst_vqc)
folds.rule: every window of a patient inherits that patient's v1 fold; no patient crosses folds

training.selection: fixed architecture and 40 epochs; no early stopping, no tuning, no outer-label selection
training.note: 40 epochs over ~13x more windows gives ~13x more optimizer updates than v1; this is part of the tested change and is not separated from the data increase

control.kind: temporal mean and population std of cepstra -> StandardScaler -> logistic regression

evaluation.primary: window macro-F1 of all-window Swin minus v1 Swin, both evaluated on the identical 1,620 v1 held-out windows (mean over seeds 0/1/2), paired patient bootstrap
secondary: same difference for window accuracy and patient-vote accuracy/macro-F1 on the 1,620 v1 windows
all-window logistic minus v1 logistic on the 1,620 v1 windows
window and patient-vote metrics on all 21,222 held-out windows (patient vote over every window of the patient)
evaluation.patient_vote_tie: lowest class index in ARR, CHF, NSR order
evaluation.interval_scope: pointwise 95% percentile intervals conditional on saved out-of-fold predictions; seeds averaged inside each draw; no retraining or multiplicity adjustment

caveats: The same 80 patients and outer folds have informed earlier decisions; this is internal evidence, not an external test.
Windows from one patient are correlated; more windows are not more independent patients.
Source database and diagnosis are confounded in ECGData.

execution.deterministic: torch deterministic algorithms, TF32 disabled, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, float32
